WITH fee_order_join AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, f.rebrate, f.feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT timespan,
    AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as match_count
  FROM fee_order_join
  GROUP BY timespan
),
avg_match_count_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) as avg_match_count
  FROM group_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT gs.avg_ratio, gs.match_count, amc.avg_match_count
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN avg_match_count_val amc
  WHERE gs.match_count > amc.avg_match_count
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios,
  SUM(match_count) as total_match_counts,
  AVG(match_count - avg_match_count) as avg_excess_match_count
FROM filtered_groups;
